terms-of-service.title: Terms of Service & Engagement
terms-of-service.shortDescription: Official terms of service governing M R S portfolio, consultations, and digital services (2026 Revision).
content: 1. Scope of Engagement: M R S provides certified professional IT Support, Remote System Administration, Cloud and Microsoft 365 Management, and Web Development services. By accessing this platform or engaging services, you agree to these terms.

2. Professional Code & Ethical Computing: All remote administration, diagnostics, and IT operations strictly adhere to industry safety standards, data integrity, and non-destructive troubleshooting protocols.
3. Document & CV Verification: Executive CV downloads and credential verification require real-person biometric verification to prevent unauthorized scraping and automated impersonation.

4. Service Availability & SLA: Services and consultations are provided with high-availability remote diagnostic tools, dedicated ticketing tracking, and direct email escalation via mr216873@gmail.com.
5. Annual Revalidation: These terms are automatically re-evaluated annually on the backend to maintain full alignment with current international technology and commercial guidelines.

privacy-policy.title: Global Privacy & Data Protection Policy
privacy-policy.shortDescription: Standards protecting visitor privacy, biometric verification data, and contact communications (2026 Edition).
content: 1. Commitment to Privacy: M R S upholds strict confidentiality regarding all client data, system logs, network diagrams, and personal contact details.

2. Biometric Verification Processing: When human verification is performed for credential downloads, captured face images are analyzed solely for liveness and identity confirmation (ICAO Doc 9303 & ISO/IEC 19794-5 standards). Captures are securely audited in backend storage and a verification notice is dispatched directly to the portfolio owner.
3. No Third-Party Resale: Personal information, email addresses, and verification files are never sold, rented, or transferred to third-party data brokers.
4. Rights of Access & Deletion: Visitors may request inspection or deletion of their contact records or verification data at any time by contacting mr216873@gmail.com.
5. Automated Annual Review: Privacy safeguards and regulatory compliance are automatically updated on an annual basis by the backend governance engine.

verification-policy.title: Biometric Human Verification & Anti-Abuse Standards
verification-policy.shortDescription: Protocols governing facial verification, live snapshot capture, and recruiter integrity (2026 Standards).
content: 1. Purpose: Biometric verification guarantees that requests for executive credentials and formal resumes originate from genuine human professionals, recruiters, and clients, deterring malicious bots and mass scrapers.
2. Capture & Audit Trail: Upon verification, a high-resolution snapshot is captured, logged with network telemetry in backend storage, and transmitted via secure email to mr216873@gmail.com.

3. Anti-Spoofing & Liveness: The verification engine utilizes AI Vision and optical symmetry, skin tone, and contrast analysis to detect and reject static photos, masks, anime/cartoons, or synthetic avatars.
4. Security Compliance: All captured media is stored with cryptographic tracking IDs to maintain verifiable proof of human verification.

cookie-ads-policy.title: Advertising, Cookies & Monetization Transparency
cookie-ads-policy.shortDescription: Disclosures regarding sponsored banner placements, CPM network integrations, and privacy (2026 Policy).
content: 1. Sponsored Ad Placements: To sustain independent research, hosting, and free public IT guides, this site includes selected high-standard advertising banners and sponsored links provided by partner CPM networks.
2. Sandboxed Display: All ad units are rendered inside sandboxed, isolated frames to prevent any unauthorized scripts from interacting with visitor session data or personal information.
3. No Tracking of Sensitive Information: Ad slots operate without access to visitor biometric data, inquiry messages, or private conversation logs.
4. Visitor Choice: Visitors are welcome to navigate all public sections, case studies, and articles with complete freedom.

ai-ethics-policy.title: Autonomous Assistant & AI Interaction Policy
ai-ethics-policy.shortDescription: Guidelines and accountability standards for M R S Assistant (2026 Governance).
content: 1. Transparent Representation: M R S Assistant represents the certified skills, professional background, and verified portfolio of M R S.
2. Voice & Tone Standards: The voice engine operates strictly with the authentic Claude AI female voice profile (Kore acoustic profile), offering courteous, articulate, and knowledgeable guidance.

3. Accurate Information: The assistant provides verified details regarding M R S's technical certifications (IT Support, Remote Administration, Web Management) and provides open, helpful technical answers without artificial limits.
